Sticky Molecules

Intermolecular forces in organic and biological molecules: name the forces, win boiling point battles, predict what mixes, and run predict-first labs on hydrogen bonds, cells in salt water and protein folding.

For this chapter: Spot the Forces first (who can hydrogen bond, and the forces in each organic family), then Boiling Point Battles and Liquids & Mixing. Every pair is the reasoning of Section 1.8: same size, so the stronger force wins; same force, so the bigger molecule wins.

Open Sticky Molecules in a new tab

Lab: H-Bond Lab. Watch hydrogen bonds form and break in water, ammonia, methanol and methane as you change the temperature.
